problems.field: participants.exclusions (separate recruitment); also repeated in notes and open_questions
problems.form_value: This sample was recruited separately from Experiment 1's and has different demographics.
problems.source_says: Experiment 1 and Experiment 2 each report recruiting 204 participants and give different demographic summaries, but the supplied paper never explicitly states that recruitment was separate or that prior participants were excluded from Experiment 2. Different demographics do not establish non-overlapping samples. The claim of separate recruitment is therefore unconfirmed; the form's adjacent statement that participation in both experiments is unknown is supported. No actual overlap was established, and a total of 408 unique people must not be inferred.
problems.quote: We recruited 204 participants in return for monetary compensation, requiring them to have experience using LLM tools.
problems.locator: PDF p. 4, Procedure, Experiment 1, Participants and procedures; p. 5, Experiment 2, Participants and procedures; complete main-text review, pp. 1-10. The external supplement and OSF data were unavailable for verification.

confirmed.statement: S1 reports 204 recruited participants and then states that participants were randomly assigned to one of four conditions in a 2 x 2 between-participants design, supporting the recorded total n_randomized = 204.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Procedure, Experiment 1, Participants and procedures, first two paragraphs.

confirmed.statement: S1 n_analyzed = 204 is explicitly supported by Fig. 2 (study 1; N = 204); the creativity analyses also report error degrees of freedom 202 for the two-group comparison and 200 for the four-cell ANOVA.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, Fig. 2 caption; p. 5, Results, Experiment 1, Self-reported creativity (expert-rated comparison) and Creativity.

confirmed.statement: S2 reports 204 recruited participants and random assignment to one of four task-complexity by LLM-response conditions, supporting the recorded total n_randomized = 204.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, Experiment 2, Participants and procedures, first two paragraphs.

confirmed.statement: S2 n_analyzed = 204 is explicitly supported by Fig. 4 (study 2; N = 204); the reported two-group tests have error degrees of freedom 202 and the four-cell creativity ANOVA has error degrees of freedom 200.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 7, Fig. 4 caption; p. 6, Results, Experiment 2, Manipulation checks, Self-reported creativity, and Creativity.

confirmed.statement: The 204 totals count individual participants. Each person is assigned to one condition, and expert scores are summarized for each participant’s ideas; neither the two raters nor idea-level ratings are the analysis sample.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 4-5, both Participants and procedures sections; p. 5, Measurements for Experiments 1 and 2.

confirmed.statement: The pools of 50 are ideas, and the 30 items delivered by each LLM are ideas. Eight people supplied the human idea pool, and the same research assistant served as human partner; these counts describe stimulus preparation and delivery, not additional randomized participants or independently randomized pairs.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 3, Materials and methods, Study materials; p. 4, continuation of Study materials, first paragraph.

confirmed.statement: No per-arm randomized or analyzed totals are printed in the supplied main PDF for any of the four S1 arms or four S2 arms. All eight arms’ n_randomized and n_analyzed values remain null; equal cell sizes cannot be assumed.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 4-7, procedures, results, and Figs. 2-5; pp. 4-5 refer condition-specific demographic information to Supplementary Tables S5 and S6.

confirmed.statement: The supplied main PDF reports no participant exclusion counts, attrition counts, or participant flow diagram. It supports the limited wording "None reported"; an independently verified zero-loss recruitment-to-analysis flow is unavailable.
confirmed.locator: Complete markdown and PDF main-article review, pp. 1-10; especially participants sections on pp. 4-5, results on pp. 5-7, and informed consent on p. 10.

confirmed.statement: Overlap between Experiments 1 and 2 is not specified, and the main paper identifies no other paper as reusing these participants. Neither the number of overlapping participants nor the total number of unique people across papers is established.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 4-5, both recruitment descriptions; complete main text and references, pp. 1-10.

confirmed.statement: Each randomized experiment independently exceeds the threshold of 50 analyzed people; eligibility does not depend on adding the two samples together.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 4-5, random assignment; p. 6, Fig. 2 (N = 204); p. 7, Fig. 4 (N = 204); creativity-codebook.md, sections 3 and 7.

confirmed.statement: The complete 380-line markdown conversion was read in successive chunks. The saved 10-page PDF has no embedded supplementary file or appended supplement; the referenced supplement and OSF data could not be examined, so the appendix, per-arm, and attrition checks remain limited to the main article.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 10, Additional information, directs readers to external supplementary material; p. 9, Data availability, links https://osf.io/9ckra/. Local file search found only the main PDF and markdown. Python urllib requests to https://www.nature.com/articles/s41599-025-05867-9, https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/9ckra/files/, and https://link.springer.com/article/10.1057/s41599-025-05867-9 all failed with WinError 10013 (socket access forbidden).

summary: Both randomized experiments report 204 people analyzed, so criterion 2 holds independently for each study. The form's claim of separately recruited samples lacks explicit support, and the external supplement could not be accessed to complete the arm-count and attrition audit.
